content.value_statement: Building CrewAI projects requires clear agent roles, task outputs, and process choices. This skill provides structured patterns for crews, planning, and workflow design.
actual_capabilities: Define CrewAI agents with roles, goals, backstories, tools, and verbosity settings.
Structure agents and tasks in YAML configuration files for CrewAI projects.
Design tasks with descriptions, expected outputs, dependencies, and context chaining.
Choose sequential or hierarchical processes for coordinated agent teams.
Enable CrewAI planning and explain how generated plans guide tasks.
Identify common CrewAI anti-patterns such as vague roles and missing expected outputs.
limitations: Requires Python 3.10 or later and the CrewAI package.
Does not execute CrewAI projects or verify runtime API credentials.
Best suited for structured workflows, not single-step prompts.
External tools used by CrewAI examples may require separate setup and permission review.

use_cases.title: Create a Starter Crew
use_cases.description: Build a basic CrewAI project with YAML agent and task definitions for a research and writing workflow.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Crew Design
use_cases.description: Check whether agent roles, task outputs, and dependencies are specific enough for reliable coordination.

use_cases.title: Plan a Coordinated Agent Workflow
use_cases.description: Map a complex business workflow into agents, tasks, process type, planning, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Agents
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CrewAI setup for [goal]. Include two or three agents, each with role, goal, backstory, and expected task output.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Workflow to YAML
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this workflow into CrewAI agent and task YAML: [workflow]. Include task dependencies and expected outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Process Type
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this CrewAI design: [design]. Recommend sequential or hierarchical process, and explain tradeoffs for coordination, speed, and quality.

prompt_templates.title: Architect a Planned Crew
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an advanced CrewAI architecture for [complex objective]. Include planning, manager coordination, task context, tool boundaries, and review checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Need a research and writing crew for a market brief.
output_examples.output: A two-agent design with a Senior Research Analyst and Content Writer, clear task responsibilities, and defined report and article outputs.

output_examples.input: My crew has vague roles and inconsistent outputs.
output: Specific role rewrites that define expertise and responsibility.
Expected output descriptions for each task.
Guidance to reduce agent count when tools can handle simple actions.

output_examples.input: Need to choose between sequential and hierarchical execution.
output_examples.output: A process recommendation based on coordination needs, task dependencies, manager oversight, and expected workflow complexity.

best_practices: Use specific agent roles that describe domain expertise and responsibility.
Define expected outputs before chaining tasks between agents.
Keep crews small unless coordination requirements justify more agents.
anti_patterns: Using generic roles such as developer or analyst without a clear specialty.
Leaving expected outputs undefined when downstream tasks need consistent inputs.
Adding many agents when one agent or tool can handle related work.

faq.question: Does this skill run CrewAI code?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance and examples. Users must run and secure their own CrewAI environment.

faq.question: What tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it design YAML configurations?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains agent and task structures for YAML-based CrewAI projects.

faq.question: Does it cover hierarchical crews?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for manager-led crews and coordination across specialized agents.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare the workflow goal, desired outputs, available tools, and any API or data boundaries.

faq.question: Is it useful for simple tasks?
faq.answer: It can help, but CrewAI is best for structured workflows with multiple responsibilities.
